slot_scores.name: unknown_typeB_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether Type B equipment has a capacity limit; it silently assumed no Type B capacity constraint in the READY_TO_MODEL model.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary objective of the production plan: to maximize daily profit, or to meet a specific minimum production target for A1 and A2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and whether it is daily profit maximization.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Type B equipment has no processing capacity limitation.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Type B capacity and did not mark it as an assumption needing confirmation; the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any Type B capacity constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 Type B capacity-limit slot remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and several constraints, but failed to ask about Type B equipment capacity and silently assumed it was unlimited before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
